mapper.select: select a.id, a.over_delivery_id, a.material_id as materialId, a.next_flag as nextFlag, a.predict_count as predictCount, a.receive_count as receiveCount, a.registration_count as registrationCount, a.batch_code as batchCode, a.remark, a.create_by as createBy, a.create_time as createTime, a.dept_id as deptId, a.dept_name as deptName, b.code as materialCode , b.finance_voucher_no, b.name as materialName, b.unit_price AS price, c.name as unitName from t_overstock_delivery_detail a left join t_material b on a.material_id = b.id left join t_unit c on b.unit_id = c.id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.over_delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
